origins.neoorigins.abyssal.name: Abyssal
origins.neoorigins.abyssal.description: A eda ti awọn jin - armored, yara ninu omi, ati anfani lati pe alagbato ore. O lọra ati ki o gbẹ lori ilẹ.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_water_breathing: Nmi omi bi nipa ti ara bi afẹfẹ ati rii ni kedere nipasẹ rẹ laisi kurukuru.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_underwater_mini: Awọn maini ni iyara ni kikun lakoko ti o wa sinu omi.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_depth_strider.d: Gbigbe ni iyara diẹ nipasẹ omi.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_swim_speed.name: Ṣii omi
power.neoorigins.aquatic_swim_speed.desc: Wẹ ni agbara kuro ni ilẹ okun, kii ṣe lẹgbẹẹ rẹ nikan.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_buoyancy.name: Afojufojufojusi
power.neoorigins.aquatic_buoyancy.descri: Dimu ijinle nigba ti ni kikun submerged dipo ti rì. Lilọ si isalẹ ṣi ṣiṣẹ deede.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_fish_diet.name: Pescivore
power.neoorigins.aquatic_fish_diet.descr: Le jẹ ẹja nikan. Awọn alabojuto olupin le mu eyi ṣiṣẹ ni atunto (ocean_origins.fish_diet_required).
power.neoorigins.aquatic_fish_diet_bonus: Aise cod ati ẹja salmon jẹ bi ajẹsara bi awọn ẹya ti a ti jinna.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_aquatic_speed.d: Nlọ nipasẹ omi pẹlu awọn ikọlu ti o lagbara, ti o munadoko - yiyara jinna ju olugbe oju-aye lọ.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_night_vision.de: Oju fara si idi òkunkun. Yipada pẹlu bọtini Iran Alẹ (aiyipada K).
power.neoorigins.abyssal_thorns_aura.des: Pada 30% ti ibajẹ ti o gba pada si awọn ikọlu.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_natural_armor.d: +2 ọkàn (+4 max HP). Awọn isedale ti okun-jinle kọ fireemu lile kan.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_underwater_mini: Awọn maini ni iyara ni kikun paapaa nigba ti o wa ninu omi.
Larada diėdiė nigba ti o wa ninu omi - aijọju 1 HP ni gbogbo iṣẹju-aaya 3.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_daylight_damage: O gba ibajẹ 1.5 fun iṣẹju kan nigbati o ba farahan si imọlẹ oorun.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_dries_out.name: Gbigbe Jade
power.neoorigins.abyssal_dries_out.descr: Afẹfẹ ami si isalẹ nigba ti o ba jade ninu omi: dada gun ju ati awọn ti o suffocate. Ojo, cauldron omi kan, Mimi omi tabi omi ti nṣiṣe lọwọ ti o wa nitosi gbogbo wọn mu kuro.
origins.neoorigins.voidwalker.name: Voidwalker
origins.neoorigins.voidwalker.descriptio: Fọwọkan nipasẹ Ipari - awọn ipele nipasẹ awọn bulọọki, ṣaju awọn ijinna kukuru, ati rin ti a ko rii nipasẹ awọn irokeke pupọ julọ. Sprints lai tiring, ṣugbọn omi jẹ irora.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_active_telep: Seju si ibi ti o n wa (to awọn bulọọki 24). Awọn idiyele 2 agbara. 80-ami cooldown.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_night_vision: Le ri ninu okunkun pipe. Yipada pẹlu bọtini Iran Alẹ (aiyipada K).
Awọn agbajo eniyan ko ṣe akiyesi wiwa rẹ ayafi ti o ba kọlu wọn.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_water_damage: Mu ipalara 1 fun iṣẹju kan nigba ti o wa ninu omi tabi ojo - ofo bẹru omi.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_no_hunger_sp: Sprinting owo ko si afikun ebi.
origins.neoorigins.stoneguard.name: Oluṣọ okuta
origins.neoorigins.stoneguard.descriptio: Ti a bi ninu okuta alãye - sentinel ti ko le gbọn ti o ta ẹgún silẹ sori awọn ikọlu, ti o wa ni ina apata pẹlu ọwọ igboro, ti o si ṣeto awọn ògùṣọ okuta didan sinu okunkun. O lọra, ṣugbọn ilẹ ti ko ni iṣipopada ko fi wọn silẹ.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_natural_armo: +3 ọkàn (+6 max HP). Ara okuta di diẹ sii ju ẹran-ara lọ.
Pada 20% ti ibaje ti o gba si awọn ikọlu.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_slow_movemen: Gbigbe 10% losokepupo ju eniyan deede lọ.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_stone_mining: Fi opin si ohun amorindun lemeji bi sare.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_no_mob_spawn: Awọn ohun ibanilẹru ko ni spawn laarin awọn bulọọki 48.
origins.neoorigins.verdant.name: Verdanti
origins.neoorigins.verdant.description: Aṣa ti o wa laaye ti aye alawọ ewe - ailagbara, ni alaafia pẹlu egan, ṣugbọn iparun patapata nipasẹ ibajẹ Nether.
power.neoorigins.verdant_mobs_ignore.des: Gbogbo awọn onijagidijagan - pẹlu awọn ọta - kọ ọ silẹ ayafi ti wọn ba binu.
Awọn gbongbo timutimu gbogbo isubu. Ko gba bibajẹ isubu.
power.neoorigins.verdant_no_hunger_sprin: Sprinting owo ko si afikun ebi.
power.neoorigins.verdant_forest_regen.de: Laiyara ṣe atunṣe ilera lakoko ti o wa ninu awọn biomes igbo.
power.neoorigins.verdant_nether_damage.d: Mu 2 bibajẹ fun keji nigba ti Nether. Awọn bata orunkun Frost Walker ni kikun ṣe idiwọ ibajẹ naa.
origins.neoorigins.umbral.name: Umbral
origins.neoorigins.umbral.description: Ọmọ ojiji - ju awọn orbs ti okunkun agbara, dashes laarin awọn ipo, ati ki o deflects ọfà. Yiyara ninu okunkun, ti oorun sun.
power.neoorigins.umbral_night_vision.des: O rii ni pipe ni okunkun pipe. Yipada pẹlu bọtini Iran Alẹ (aiyipada K).
power.neoorigins.umbral_active_dash.name: Ojiji ojiji
power.neoorigins.umbral_active_dash.desc: Ti nwaye siwaju ni iyara giga ni itọsọna ti o nlọ. Awọn idiyele 2 agbara. 60-ami cooldown.
O gba ibajẹ 1 fun iṣẹju kan nigbati o farahan si imọlẹ orun taara.
power.neoorigins.umbral_projectile_immun: Awọn itọka kọja laiseniyan nipasẹ fọọmu ti ojiji ojiji rẹ.
power.neoorigins.umbral_no_hunger_sprint: Sprinting owo ko si afikun ebi.
power.neoorigins.umbral_shadow_orb.name: Ojiji Orb
power.neoorigins.umbral_shadow_orb.descr: Gbe orb alaihan ti o wọ rediosi-idina 28 sinu Okunkun. Titi di awọn orbs 4 ṣiṣẹ ni ẹẹkan; gbigbe titun kan yọ awọn Atijọ. Awọn idiyele 2 agbara. 60-ami cooldown.
power.neoorigins.feline_active_launch.de: Fi agbara mu ọ ni itọsọna ti o n wa. Awọn idiyele 2 agbara. 4-keji itutu.
power.neoorigins.draconic_flight.name: Dragon Iyẹ
power.neoorigins.draconic_flight.descrip: Glides larọwọto nipasẹ afẹfẹ nipa lilo awọn iyẹ draconic ti o lagbara.
power.neoorigins.draconic_active_firebal: Mimi ti nwaye ti awọn bọọlu ina 4 ni itọsọna ti o n wa. Awọn idiyele 3 stamina. 4-keji itutu.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_crop_growth.name: Ibukun Iseda
power.neoorigins.sylvan_crop_growth.desc: Awọn irugbin ti o wa nitosi dagba yiyara ni iwaju rẹ, bi ẹnipe ilẹ bukun.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_active_root.name: Dipọ
power.neoorigins.sylvan_active_root.desc: Awọn gbongbo gbogbo awọn ẹda ti o wa nitosi ni aye pẹlu Slowness VI ti o lagbara fun awọn aaya 4. Awọn idiyele 2 vitality. 200-ami itutu.
power.neoorigins.revenant_active_phase.d: Awọn ipele nipasẹ odi to lagbara ni itọsọna ti o n wa. 3-keji itutu.
power.neoorigins.revenant_active_bolt.de: Ṣe ina boluti ti agbara gbigbẹ ti o gbamu sinu agbegbe owusu ipalara. Awọn idiyele 1 agbara. 4-keji itutu.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_starting_triden: Ti funni ni trident enchanted ti o lagbara (Mending, Unbreaking III, Riptide III) nigbati o yan ipilẹṣẹ yii.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_scare_ocean.des: Awọn ẹda okun palolo - squid, ẹja, ẹja - sa fun ọ ni oju.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_active_phase: Pari nipasẹ odi ti o lagbara ni itọsọna ti o n wa. Awọn idiyele 3 agbara. 80-ami cooldown.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_active_glows: Gbe a glowstone Àkọsílẹ ni dada ti o ba nwa ni. 100-ami itutu.
power.neoorigins.verdant_harvest_bonus.d: Bibu awọn irugbin ti o dagba tabi awọn igi ṣoki n mu idasilo afikun kan.
item.neoorigins.orb_of_origin.not_enough: O nilo awọn ipele iriri %s lati lo eyi.
jei.neoorigins.orb_of_origin.info: Tun gbogbo awọn yiyan ipilẹṣẹ tunto ati tun ṣi oluyan ipilẹṣẹ. Awọn idiyele awọn ipele 5 XP fun lilo iṣaaju (lilo akọkọ jẹ ọfẹ). Je lori lilo.
emi.neoorigins.orb_of_origin.info: Tun gbogbo awọn yiyan ipilẹṣẹ tunto ati tun ṣi oluyan ipilẹṣẹ. Awọn idiyele awọn ipele 5 XP fun lilo iṣaaju (lilo akọkọ jẹ ọfẹ). Je lori lilo.
item.neoorigins.orb_of_class.not_enough_: O nilo awọn ipele iriri %s lati lo eyi.
jei.neoorigins.orb_of_class.info: Tun yiyan kilasi rẹ nikan ṣe ati tun ṣi oluyan kilasi, ti o tọju orisun akọkọ rẹ. Awọn idiyele 2 awọn ipele XP fun lilo. Je lori lilo.
emi.neoorigins.orb_of_class.info: Tun yiyan kilasi rẹ nikan ṣe ati tun ṣi oluyan kilasi, ti o tọju orisun akọkọ rẹ. Awọn idiyele 2 awọn ipele XP fun lilo. Je lori lilo.
origins.neoorigins.inchling.name: Inchling
origins.neoorigins.inchling.description: Humanoid ti o ni iwọn mẹẹdogun ti o ṣe iwọn awọn odi pẹlu irọrun ati gbigbe pẹlu iyara iyalẹnu - ṣugbọn ara ẹlẹgẹ wa pẹlu agbegbe naa.
power.neoorigins.inchling_size.name: Idinku
Le faramọ ati iwọn eyikeyi dada.
power.neoorigins.inchling_no_fall_damage: Nitorina imole ti isubu ko dun rara.
power.neoorigins.inchling_reduced_health: -5 ọkàn (-10 max HP). Ara ti o ni iwọn mẹẹdogun ni o ni idamẹrin ijiya naa.
power.neoorigins.inchling_hunger_efficie: N ni ebi npa idaji bi sare bi a deede player.
origins.neoorigins.sporeling.name: Sporeling
origins.neoorigins.sporeling.description: Ẹda olu ti o ṣe rere ni okunkun ati awọn aaye olu - ti o ni ihamọra pẹlu awọn spores majele, ṣugbọn ti oorun ti gbẹ.
power.neoorigins.sporeling_spore_cloud.d: Ina kan spore projectile ti o erupts sinu kan duro awọsanma ti oloro spores. Awọn idiyele 3 vitality. 12-keji itutu.
power.neoorigins.sporeling_poison_immuni: Ajesara si gbogbo awọn ipa majele.
Le ri kedere ni lapapọ òkunkun. Yipada pẹlu bọtini Iran Alẹ (aiyipada K).
